name: manual_e84373
claim: On Windows, Node and npm come from the LM Studio shims in the user profile .lmstudio\bin directory, with the npm package under .lmstudio\tools\npm. npx.cmd is not copied into the shim directory; startup must also put that package bin on PATH. Do not reinstall Node or symlink tools into the versioned LM Studio app folder.

decisions.notes: start.ps1 readiness failed because npm.cmd was present and npx.cmd was only inside the npm package bin. Prepending the shim directory was not enough.

rationale: start.ps1 readiness failed because npm.cmd was present and npx.cmd was only inside the npm package bin. Prepending the shim directory was not enough.
